name: Stapler
instruction: Create a 3D model of a stapler. It should be compact and fit comfortably in one hand. The top part should be able to pivot open for refilling staples.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a stapler.
The stapler has a compact design.
The top part of the stapler is designed to pivot open.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The dimensions of the stapler are proportionate for hand-held use.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The pivot mechanism is correctly positioned for easy access.
The stapler maintains stability when the top part is opened.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
